entries.description: Archived conversation management for DeepSeek Harness with restore, permanent deletion, bulk cleanup, and 30-day retention.
Regenerates an assistant reply inside the current DeepSeek Harness session without creating a new conversation.
Live browser webcam snapshots as a native DeepSeek Harness vision tool for conversations and goals.
DeepSeek Harness chat-flow performance plugin: optimize very long streamed assistant reasoning with optional off-screen rendering.
DeepSeek Harness computer use in physical virtual-desktop pixels, with reliable input, multi-monitor support, and a visible safety overlay.
DeepSeek Harness plugin manager with enable/disable controls, safe archive installation, and online updates.
去 AI 味 companion for dsh-w-noval-write: writing rules, a deterministic prose scanner and /deslop, active only in conversations linked to a novel with /write.
DeepSeek Harness transparent image upload bridge: keep the original image in the transcript while dsh-w-vision supplies text context to non-vision models.

A durable cross-session Markdown knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness agents with two switchable modes: an assistant memory (kb_save/kb_search/kb_read/kb_list/kb_delete/kb_import), and a writing mode that turns the same store into a human-prose style corpus (feed reference novels, retrieve passages for texture) with an anti-AI-flavour prompt and an editable banned-cliché list. Encoding-aware import splits Markdown on headings and Chinese novel .txt on chapters; a browser panel drives both modes.

Several novels per workspace, one folder each, with conversations bound to a novel; novel canon with schema-v5 genre extensions, structured volume/chapter outlines, a foreshadowing and payoff ledger, manuscripts linked to outline chapters with live word counts, a per-book knowledge-base style library, version history with compare and restore, live panel sync, targeted AI tools, verified manuscript export, and a persistent /write task.
DeepSeek Harness persona manager with reusable persona templates and an optional hidden four-message conversation preset.
Connect relay and custom-provider models to DeepSeek Harness's native reasoning-effort selector.
A reusable right-side sidebar shell for DeepSeek Harness W-series features.
Routing-suite-compatible DeepSeek Harness preset with task routing, near-field guidance, mode tools, and a live w-persona second prompt.
DeepSeek Harness advisory teacher model with bounded read-only workspace investigation for diagnosing blocked tasks.
DeepSeek Harness vision relay for screen capture, local image files, and safe user-upload analysis.
Full-workspace image and video wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness with persistent local media, configurable blur, and video speed.

A whale-girl feature page mounted in dsh-w-right-sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: a supplied transparent whale-girl illustration with expressive idle motion, a pixel heart filled with flowing red liquid measuring this conversation's lewdness, and a per-conversation memory window.
